challenge.name: Safe House
challenge.description: The safe house processes reports and files notes for the field. Get past the front desk and into the vault.

records.findings_summary: Flag found via ROP stack overflow in the parent shell's SUBMIT handler to craft a type-3 vault frame with a negative slot index (-4) that reaches the pre-initialized flag-file descriptor, then RELAY reads back the vault response.: sun{n3gat1ve_h4ndl3s_0pen_s3cret_d00rs} | Evidence: Metadata: Pwn 'Safe House', nc chal.sunshinectf.games 26007, service binary sha256 40c8993c... ; Binary forks: parent reads commands (SUBMIT/RELAY/NOTE), child holds flag.txt fd and serves a 16-slot vault with 4 pre-initialized type-2 source entries at 0x405080 (entry0 fd=flag.txt); slot array base 0x4060b0. ; Child read handler checks index only with `cmp eax,0xf; jg range` (no lower bound), so index=-4 maps to 0x4060b0-0x1030=0x405080 (flag fd) and preads the flag. ; SUBMIT <size> reads `size` bytes into a 0x40 stack buffer (offset 0x48 to return), and seccomp in the parent permits read/write, enabling a ROP chain. ; Leaked the per-connection XOR key via write(1, 0x405060/61, 3) using rdx=3 carried over from the handler; keystream is key bytes reversed (k3 k2 k1 k0).
solution_steps: Run the provided service and reach the 'sh> ' prompt.

Stage 1 (SUBMIT 255 overflow): write 3 bytes at 0x405060 and 3 at 0x405061 to stdout to leak all 4 key bytes, then MULTIPOP to set rbx/rbp/r12/r13/r14/r15 and return to the command loop (0x4014d0) with rbp/RX pointing at a BSS command buffer.
Compute keystream = leaked_key[::-1]; frame = plain XOR keystream where plain = {type=3, len=5, pad=0, payload = 0xfffffffc, pad}.
Stage 2 (SUBMIT 255 overflow): read 9 frame bytes + a '1\0' string into BSS using read(0, ...) with rdx=3.
Stage 3 (SUBMIT 255 overflow): write the 9 frame bytes to fd 3 (three 3-byte writes) so the child processes the negative-index vault read and queues the flag.
Send 'RELAY 1': the parent reads the already-queued flag response and prints the decrypted flag.
evidence: Metadata: Pwn 'Safe House', nc chal.sunshinectf.games 26007, service binary sha256 40c8993c...

Binary forks: parent reads commands (SUBMIT/RELAY/NOTE), child holds flag.txt fd and serves a 16-slot vault with 4 pre-initialized type-2 source entries at 0x405080 (entry0 fd=flag.txt); slot array base 0x4060b0.
Child read handler checks index only with `cmp eax,0xf; jg range` (no lower bound), so index=-4 maps to 0x4060b0-0x1030=0x405080 (flag fd) and preads the flag.
SUBMIT <size> reads `size` bytes into a 0x40 stack buffer (offset 0x48 to return), and seccomp in the parent permits read/write, enabling a ROP chain.
Leaked the per-connection XOR key via write(1, 0x405060/61, 3) using rdx=3 carried over from the handler; keystream is key bytes reversed (k3 k2 k1 k0).
Loaded 9-byte encrypted frame [03 00 05 00 fc ff ff ff 00] into BSS and wrote it to fd3, queuing the vault flag response; 'RELAY 1' then made the parent decrypt/print it.
